result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and continuous sidewalks, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide curb radii and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or refuge islands increase exposure to vehicular traffic in this residential setting.

hazards.name: Wide curb radius
hazards.description: The wide corner radius on the left allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, which can lead to uncertainty for pedestrians regarding when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles by tightening the corner radius.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear guidance for crossing.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane intersection with marked crosswalks and sidewalks. The large crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge islands increase exposure to vehicle traffic in an institutional and residential setting.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a midpoint refuge.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corners appear designed for high-speed vehicle turns, which can increase the risk of collisions with pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at corners to shorten crossing distances and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and overhead traffic signals, but the pedestrian environment is compromised by wide crossing distances and faded pavement markings. A significant portion of the image is obscured by blurring, limiting the visibility of potential hazards on the left side of the roadway.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb on the right may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint crosswalks using high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
